descriptionChirho: The feminine noun אַוָּה meaning 'desire, longing, craving', often in construct chains ('desire of') denoting strong want or appetite. All 7 occurrences express the same semantic concept of intense wanting, with variation only in grammatical frame (construct state vs. pronominal suffix). Multilingual evidence: eng 'desire', spa 'deseo', hin इच्छा / चाहत, arb شَهْوَة / رَغبَة, kor 소원 / 욕망, swa 'tamaa/shauku/hamu'. The 1cs suffixed form (S80463 'my desire') adds only possessive morphology, not a new sense.
